items.title: Launch Manager
items.content_html:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

The role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Launch professional to drive the introduction of our new Vehicle (BEV-PHEV/Super Hybrid) models. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the launch process, including coordination with sales, after-sales, logistics, marketing and engineering teams to ensure a seamless and successful market introduction. This role requires excellent project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

This is what you will do:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive launch plan for new Zeekr models, including timelines, milestones, and KPIs to ensure successful market introduction.

  • Lead the launch of a specific model of Zeekr line up, coordinating activities with all relevant department in S&M teams (sales, after-sales, marketing and logistics) aligning with R&D organization both in China and Sweden.

  • Lead the presentation of the model to internal stakeholders (by leveraging a dedicated Product Bulleting) and external stakeholders, including journalists

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement and adjust the launch strategy accordingly.

  • Create and maintain detailed project documentation, including launch schedules, budgets, and risk assessments, to ensure timely completion of tasks and effective communication among stakeholders.

  • Coordinate the overall launch activities with internal stakeholders both at headquarter and local markets.

  • Continuously evaluate the success of launch activities and provide regular progress updates to senior management and other stakeholders.

  • Lead model performance management, assessing launch activities and sales funnel results by country, implementing the necessary actions to secure the EU sales target by model, in coordination with HQ and Market teams.

Collaboration:

  • Work with product development and engineering teams to address and resolve any technical issues that may arise during the launch process.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop sales forecasts, pricing strategies, and sales enablement tools to facilitate the successful introduction of new Zeekr models.

  • Coordinate with after-sales teams to ensure the availability of spare parts, service centers, and customer support resources for new EV models.

  • Work closely with logistics teams to optimize inventory management, transportation, and distribution strategies to support the launch and ongoing sales of new EV models.

  • Coordinate with marketing and PR teams to develop and execute promotional strategies, campaigns, and events to drive awareness and demand for new Zeekr models. The activity includes the preparation of the press kit from product side.

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in product launch management, preferably in European (luxury) OEMs.

  • Strong project management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple projects. simultaneously, with focus on meeting deadlines and sales results.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, up to external stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

  • Knowledge of EV and PHEV technology, market trends, and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience in sales, marketing, after-sales, and logistics is a plus.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, project management tools, and CRM software.

To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note that due to GDPR regulations we can only accept applications sent through the recruitment system, not via email or other channels. We do not accept applications submitted by external recruitment companies.

items.content_html:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

The role
As a Data Privacy Counsel, you will support the implementation of the ZEEKR Data Privacy Strategy, acting as data privacy specialist to support internal teams and help develop a privacy by design mind-set.

This is what you will do:

  • Conduct data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) for new projects or initiatives involving the processing of personal data.

  • Provide guidance to internal teams on data privacy best practices and ensure compliance with privacy requirements, measure process effectiveness, and develop action items to remediate identified risks.

  • Manage and respond to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other privacy-related inquiries from individuals and authorities.

  • Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (RoPA), and privacy-by-design reviews for new products, features, and vehicle data flows

  • Manage Data Transfer Impact Assessments for EU cross-border personal data transfers.

  • Draft and implement data privacy policies and procedures in accordance with applicable data protection laws and regulations.

  • Draft, review and negotiate Data Processing Agreements.

  • Develop and maintain internal privacy policies, notices, and training materials tailored to automotive and connected-vehicle data processing.

  • Support data privacy audits (both internal and external audits).

  • Partner with IT security, product, and engineering teams on privacy engineering matters and vendor due diligence.

  • Support pan-EU Data Privacy team on data privacy matters across all EU markets.

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

  • 3+ years of experience in of relevant experience in data protection/privacy law, ideally combining law firm and in-house experience in a technology companies.

  • Good understanding and knowledge of the GDPR and data privacy legislation more generally.

  • Good understanding of technology, SaaS and Cloud operations; familiarity with automotive, connected-device, or IoT data issues is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a lean, fast-moving Data Privacy EU team and willing to build processes and templates from scratch.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work with international teams (including a teams based in China) and non-legal business functions.

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to assess risk and impact to individuals from a privacy and data protection perspective.

  • Ability to be a team player who enjoys working within a global team.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work to tight deadlines.

  • CIPP/E or similar EU equivalent privacy qualification is desirable.

You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. items.content_html:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

Our cars have finally arrived in Europe, and with several markets on our expansion roadmap, there has never been a better time to join the team.

The role
As an International Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategic sales agenda for Leaseco’s and Mobility companies in Europe. In addition to having the top LeaseCo’s to manage, you will define the strategy and set standards for the International Leaseco’s across Europe. You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with your clients and managing the full end-to-end customer journey.
You will also partner with local teams to help them refine their strategies, deeply understand their problems, and drive programs to improve the overall business sales process. The International Key Account Manager will leverage senior-level international relationships to generate vehicle sales, drive repeat business, define policies, and to chart a path for Zeekr to become the preferred OEM.

This is what you will do:

  • Own the relationship for large international leasing companies, ensuring a great customer journey and ownership experience throughout.

  • Leverage existing leasing company relationships and/or partner with all existing Leasing channels to grow sales within this segment.

  • Establish and manage all contractual agreements with these customers; where applicable.

  • Meet sales objectives by driving new account creation, deliverable orders, scheduling sales meetings, and making the best use of available assets (e.g. vehicles for test drives) as well as driving strong AR performance with clients to ensure timely payments for existing products and services.

  • Actively partner with HQ and local team to develop a cohesive strategy for the growth of vehicle sales in Europe.

  • Ensure teams are equipped with the tools and resources necessary to succeed.

  • Manage the overall business plan by working with other departments.

  • Drive our customers’ success by acting as a facilitator to meet their needs.

  • Conduct competitor analysis on a regular basis.

  • Actively collaborate with Zeekr teams (field fleet managers) to provide coaching and training on Business-to-Business sales.

  • Use Zeekr’s Customer Relation Management system and tools to log appointments, calls, test drives, contacts and meeting notes.

  • Ensure customers are fulfilling their contractual obligations (e.g. payment terms).

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

  • A customer-oriented mindset with a strong understanding of sales processes and customer satisfaction principles.

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to deal successfully with customers and colleagues.

  • A large business network including the main leasing and mobility companies.

  • Very results and solution oriented and able to investigate and weigh different solutions and outcomes.

  • Collaborative with the ability to work well in a team with colleagues from different departments.

  • Fluency in English is required. And a second European language is plus.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Possess a rare combination of mental agility, analytical thinking, hands-on problem solving, and a customer-service mindset.

You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. You will be responsible for maximizing revenue, profitability, and customer loyalty through the development and execution of commercial strategies across parts, services, service contracts, customer programs, and after sales campaigns. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Aftersales, Marketing, Finance, Logistics, Product Management, and external partners, you will ensure a consistent and profitable after sales proposition that supports Zeekr's growth ambitions.

items.content_html:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

The role
The Supply Chain Specialist is responsible for managing the end-to-end supply chain activities for the Accessories & Merchandise business across Europe. The role ensures the seamless planning, procurement, distribution, and inventory management of accessories and merchandise products, supporting both market demand and business growth objectives. Working closely with National Sales Companies (NSCs), importers, suppliers, distribution centers, and internal stakeholders, the specialist drives supply chain efficiency, product availability, and continuous process improvement.

This is what you will do:

• Consolidate and analyze annual and monthly demand forecasts from European markets and importers to develop accurate supply plans.

• Create and communicate supplier forecasts to support capacity planning and ensure supply continuity.

• Manage purchasing activities with global OEM suppliers, including Zeekr China and Geely China, as well as selected European suppliers.

• Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics activities with suppliers, Central Distribution Centers (CDC), and Local Distribution Centers (LDC) to ensure timely product availability.

• Prepare and manage customs and import/export documentation for non-EU transactions and special customs regions.

• Monitor and optimize inventory levels by balancing vehicle sales forecasts, accessory take rates, supplier lead times, and stock targets.

• Track supply chain performance and proactively mitigate supply risks, shortages, and excess inventory.

• Develop and distribute regular inventory, sales, and supply chain performance reports to internal and external stakeholders.

• Ensure product master data, pricing information, and purchasing conditions remain aligned with contractual agreements.

• Monitor supplier pricing, product cost developments, and retail pricing structures to support profitability objectives.

• Identify opportunities for process, system, and operational improvements that enhance supply chain efficiency and customer satisfaction.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product Management, Aftersales, Logistics, Finance, and external partners to support business objectives.

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with hands-on supply chain experience, demonstrating the ability to translate market demand into effective procurement and inventory strategies. The role requires excellent stakeholder management, attention to detail, and the capability to operate in a fast-paced, international OEM environment where service level, cost efficiency, and product availability are critical:

  • Supply Chain & Analytical Expertise

  • Planning & Organizational Skills

  • Stakeholder Management

  • Continuous Improvement & Business Acumen

Personal Attributes

• Proactive and self-driven.

• Structured and well-organized.

• Result-oriented with strong ownership mentality.

• Team player with a collaborative attitude.

• Flexible and adaptable in a rapidly evolving business environment.

• Strong intercultural awareness and ability to work within an international organization.

Required Experience

• 3-5 years of experience in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Inventory Management, Procurement, or Logistics.

• Experience in the automotive industry, aftermarket, accessories business, retail supply chain, or consumer goods environment is strongly preferred.

• Experience working with international suppliers and distribution networks.

• Experience in forecasting, replenishment planning, and stock optimization.

• Familiarity with import/export processes and customs regulations is considered an advantage.

• Experience working in a European or multinational business environment.

Education & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

• APICS, CPIM, CSCP, Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent supply chain certifications are considered an advantage.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.

• Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.

• Experience with supply chain planning tools and reporting systems is preferred.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken. Additional European languages are considered an advantage.

The Company

Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

The role
We are seeking a highly motivated Salesforce Technical Consultant with 4-5 years of Salesforce experience. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business requirements are translated into scalable, efficient, and maintainable Salesforce solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Salesforce out of-the-box capabilities, customization options, integrations, and service processes. The role requires daily collaboration with an offshore development team while closely partnering with business stakeholders across multiple European markets

This is what you will do:

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Management

• Engage with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, processes, pain points, and requirements.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution discussions.

• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure delivery of optimal business value.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Care, Marketing, Operations, and Aftersales teams.

• Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate progress, risks, and recommendations.

Solution Design

• Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution designs.

• Identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce standard functionality before proposing custom development.

• Collaborate with Salesforce Architects and Developers to design scalable solutions aligned with Salesforce best practices.

• Ensure solutions are future-proof and support business growth.

Delivery & Team Collaboration

• Work closely with offshore Salesforce development teams on a daily basis.

• Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.

• Review delivered solutions against business requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and support defect resolution.

• Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer.

Integration & Platform Support

• Support integration initiatives between Salesforce and external platforms.

• Work on customer service and omnichannel engagement solutions.

• Participate in data migration, data quality, and process automation initiatives.

• Help define monitoring, exception handling, and support processes for integrations.

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

• 4-5 years of Salesforce experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Salesforce Consultant.

• Proven experience interacting directly with business stakeholders and senior management.

• Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.

• Experience working with distributed development teams.

• Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.

Salesforce Expertise

Strong experience with:

• Sales Cloud • Service Cloud

• Lead Management • Opportunity Management

• Case Management

• Reports & Dashboards

• Flows and Automation

• Approval Processes

• Salesforce Security Model

• Custom Objects and Fields

• Validation Rules

• Permission Sets and Sharing Rules

• Record Types and Page Layouts

Integration Experience

• REST/SOAP APIs

• Salesforce Integrations

• Middleware platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica, or similar)

• SFTP-based integrations • Data migration and synchronization projects

• Salesforce Omni-Channel

• Amazon Connect (AWS Voice/CTI Integration)

• Service Console

• Experience Cloud

• Digital customer journey implementations

• Automotive industry processes

• Customer support and contact center operations Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

• Salesforce Administrator

• Salesforce Business Analyst

• Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Excellent requirement gathering and documentation skills.

items.content_html:
Das Unternehmen

Mit modernster Technologie und konsequenter Kundenorientierung gestalten wir die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit.

Die Rolle

Wir bieten ein Praktikum Sales & Customer Experience (m/w/d) an, mit diesem Praktikum sammelst du wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in den Bereichen Automobilvertrieb, Customer Journey Management und kommerzielle Geschäftsprozesse. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld zusammen.

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, praktische Kenntnisse in der Kundenkommunikation, Lead-Qualifizierung, CRM-Systemen und beratungsorientiertem Vertrieb aufzubauen und gleichzeitig zum Wachstum einer schnell expandierenden Premium-Elektrofahrzeugmarke beizutragen.

Du erhältst wertvolle Einblicke darin, wie ein modernes Automobilunternehmen Kunden gewinnt, begeistert und erfolgreich bis zum Kauf begleitet. Für leistungsstarke Praktikantinnen und Praktikanten eröffnet diese Rolle zudem potenzielle Karrieremöglichkeiten bei Zeekr, während wir unser Geschäft in Europa weiter ausbauen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als erste Ansprechperson für potenzielle Kundinnen und Kunden spielst du eine wichtige Rolle dabei, bereits beim ersten Kontakt ein herausragendes Kundenerlebnis zu schaffen. Du kommunizierst mit Interessenten, qualifizierst Leads, beantwortest produktbezogene Fragen und koordinierst Probefahrten. Dabei begleitest du Kunden entlang ihres gesamten Kaufprozesses.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Retail Operations und Customer Experience erhältst du Einblicke in zentrale kommerzielle Aktivitäten und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum unseres Unternehmens bei.

Diese Position eignet sich besonders für Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, die eine solide Grundlage in Vertrieb, Kundenbetreuung und der schnell wachsenden Elektromobilitätsbranche aufbauen möchten.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Nachverfolgung eingehender Leads und Kundenanfragen über Telefon sowie digitale Kanäle.

  • Qualifizierung von Leads durch Bewertung des Kundeninteresses und der Kaufabsicht.

  • Planung und Koordination von Probefahrten für Interessenten.

  • Bereitstellung von Informationen zu Fahrzeugspezifikationen, Verfügbarkeit, Preisen, Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten und Bestellprozessen.

  • Pflege und Aktualisierung von Kundendaten im CRM-System.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur Sicherstellung einer nahtlosen Customer Journey.

  • Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen in Prozessen sowie Weitergabe von Kundenfeedback und Erkenntnissen.

  • Unterstützung der Vertriebsziele durch maximale Kundeninteraktion und optimale Nutzung von Lead-Konvertierungsmöglichkeiten.

Das bringst du mit

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, verfügst du über:

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Erste Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Telesales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Position.

  • Großes Interesse an Mobilität, Technologie und Elektromobilität.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.

  • Eine kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Ergebnisorientierung.

  • Eine proaktive, belastbare und flexible Herangehensweise an Aufgaben.

  • Die Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen und teamorientierten Umfeld erfolgreich zu arbeiten.

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce oder anderen CRM-Systemen ist von Vorteil.

Arbeiten bei Zeekr

Um bei Zeekr erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du den Mut mit, vertrauensvoll und verantwortungsbewusst zu handeln. Du scheust dich nicht davor, selbst aktiv mit anzupacken. Du bist innovationsfreudig und kannst dich schnell an Veränderungen in einem dynamischen, anspruchsvollen und schnelllebigen Arbeitsumfeld anpassen.

Wie wir glaubst auch du daran, dass die Arbeit in einem internationalen und multikulturellen Umfeld bereichernd ist. Du schätzt Vielfalt und bringst die Bereitschaft mit, unterschiedliche Menschen, Perspektiven und Arbeitsstile offen anzunehmen.

Bewirb dich noch heute. Wir führen während des Bewerbungszeitraums fortlaufend Auswahlgespräche und freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

Bitte beachte, dass wir aufgrund der DSGVO-Bestimmungen ausschließlich Bewerbungen berücksichtigen können, die über unser Bewerbersystem eingereicht werden. Bewerbungen per E-Mail oder über andere Kanäle können leider nicht angenommen werden. Ebenso akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen, die durch externe Personalvermittlungen eingereicht werden.

items.content_html:
The Company

We are Geely Auto Europe, operating under Geely Auto International Corporation. The organization manages two brands – Geely and Zeekr – and supports business activities across nearly 20 European countries. As procurement team in this company, we provide scalable, compliant and high-quality procurement support, covering marketing, aftersales, IT, HR and other professional services to enable sustainable brand growth in Europe.

The role
Your role will be to lead and support end-to-end indirect procurement activities across a broad range of categories and projects, based on the needs of the team and management decisions. The category scope may include, but is not limited to, HR, Professional Services, IT, Logistics, Marketing, and other indirect procurement areas. These categories are examples only; depending on business priorities, some may not be part of the final assignment while other categories or projects may be added. You will partner closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs, develop sourcing strategies, benchmark suppliers and market trends, and ensure that purchasing activities deliver value, compliance, and efficiency.

This is what you will do:

  • You will be part of the Procurement team and will be assigned to different indirect procurement projects according to team priorities, workload, and management decisions. The scope may include categories such as HR, Professional Services, IT, Logistics, Marketing, or other indirect spend areas, depending on the business need at the time.

  • You will collaborate cross-functionally with business stakeholders to align sourcing activities, leverage synergies, and share best practices.

  • You will lead sourcing activities, including RFI/RFP/RFQ processes, supplier negotiations, commercial evaluations, and compliance management, ensuring that tendering and supplier selection processes are executed in a transparent, compliant, and well-documented manner.

  • You will develop and implement sourcing and category strategies for the indirect procurement projects assigned to you, continuously identifying opportunities for cost optimization, process improvement, risk mitigation, and value creation together with internal customers.

This is what you will bring:

  • At least 5 years of experience in Procurement, preferably with solid exposure to indirect procurement categories or service-related spend areas such as HR, Professional Services, IT, Logistics, Marketing, or similar, while being comfortable moving across different categories and projects as priorities evolve.

  • A proven track record of delivering successful sourcing projects, optimizing spend, improving commercial terms, and building genuine relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong negotiation skills and experience establishing contracts, framework agreements, and long-lasting partnerships with service providers, agencies, consultants, technology suppliers, logistics providers, and other indirect suppliers.

  • Ability to influence, guide, and challenge cross-functional stakeholders in a constructive way, balancing business needs with procurement governance, compliance, and value creation.

  • You are energetic, hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable working with several categories and stakeholders in parallel, with strong communication skills and a pragmatic mindset.

  • University degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or a similar relevant field.

  • Experience working in an international environment, together with knowledge of procurement systems such as SAP or similar tools, is considered a plus.

  • Adaptable to fast-changing environments and resilient under pressure.

Our cars have finally arrived in Europe, and with several markets on our expansion roadmap, there has never been a better time to join the team.

The role
As a Sales Operations and Logistics Lead, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the efficient planning, allocation, ordering, and delivery of vehicles across the market. Acting as the bridge between local teams, logistics partners, retailers, and our European headquarters, you will oversee end-to-end sales operations and logistics processes to ensure the right vehicles reach the right customers at the right time.

This is what you will do:

Sales Operations & Logistics

  • Own volume planning, forecasting, and order management processes for the market.

  • Manage vehicle allocation, VIN matching, VIN reallocation, and internal fleet operations in close collaboration with central Sales Operations teams.

  • Ensure efficient vehicle availability and distribution through a 3R approach: delivering the right car, at the right time, in the right location.

  • Monitor inventory levels and proactively identify opportunities to optimize stock and delivery performance.

  • Coordinate logistics activities with local partners and the central logistics organization to ensure seamless vehicle flows.

Order & Delivery Management

  • Facilitate clear communication regarding order statuses, vehicle availability, and delivery timelines.

  • Ensure fast and accurate order processing and execution.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics providers, suppliers, and key operational partners.

  • Act as the primary liaison between the local market and the European headquarters, ensuring alignment and smooth operational processes.

Retail Operations Support

  • Support vehicle registration processes and sales funnel management activities.

  • Develop, monitor, and report on operational KPIs and sales performance metrics.

  • Provide regular reporting and actionable insights to support business decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with local sales teams and central sales operations to improve operational performance and customer experience.

Product & Pricing Support

  • Analyze market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to support product strategy.

  • Provide recommendations regarding product positioning, features, accessories, and trim levels to ensure a competitive market offering.

  • Conduct trim-walk analyses, price ladder assessments, price index benchmarking, and competitive analyses.

  • Monitor relevant government regulations, EV incentives, and policy developments impacting the market.

  • Collaborate with the central Product & Pricing team to optimize local product and pricing strategies.

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Planning, Logistics, or Supply Chain, preferably within automotive or a related industry.

  • Proven experience with forecasting, order management, inventory planning, and logistics coordination.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable business insights.

  • Experience managing KPIs, reporting, and sales performance metrics.

  • Excellent planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across international teams.

  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Coordinate local events, exhibitions, pop-ups and customer engagement initiatives.

  • Manage local campaign execution across digital and social channels.

  • Maintain and coordinate local content calendars and social media activities in alignment with Nordic communication direction.

  • Support implementation of Nordic communication platforms, campaigns and partnerships in the Swedish market.

  • Manage lead handling processes and customer pipeline activities via Salesforce.

  • Follow activation budgets and purchase request processes.

  • Coordinate with agencies and external partners on local campaign execution and production.

  • Provide local market insights and commercial input to Nordic and European teams.

  • Strong understanding of performance marketing and retail activation.

  • Experience managing local campaigns and lead generation activities.

  • Project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

  • Commercial mindset with strong execution capability.

  • Experience working with dealer networks or retail-driven organizations is considered a strong advantage.

items.title: Regional Product Marketing Lead (Benelux)
items.content_html:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision are to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

Our cars have arrived in Europe, and with several markets on our expansion roadmap, there has never been a better time to join the team.

The role
Our team is looking for a Regional Product Marketing Lead. This role is the local extension of Zeekr Europe’s SDV Product & GTM department, in charge of securing the local launch readiness and a successful initial market introduction.

You will take the lead in providing market feedback on the Product Performance that will be integrated into the Life Cycle Management (LCM) measures development.

This role is composed by two phases:

Launch Phase:

In the product launch phase, you will oversee all aspects of the local launch process, including coordination with marketing, sales, after-sales, and logistics teams to ensure a seamless and successful market introduction.

Post Launch Phase:

After the market introduction you will monitor the regional product performance and co-create appropriate LCM-activities to meet the commercial targets.

This is what you will do most of the time:

Regional Launch Readiness

  • Alignment of all local departments during launch preparation,

  • Co-developing the product guide and cascading new product information throughout the regional organizations and work streams,

  • Translating the right product messaging and assets. Adaptation of marketing collateral in local languages,

  • Driving the Local launch events in the Region,

  • Own and maintain the Local Product Website content,

  • Product Performance Measurement and Monitoring after launch as input for post-launch activities.

Regional Product Marketing

  • Act as the local Product Specialist (incl. connectivity) for retail locations, business partners and media. 

  • Train and support field staff on product knowledge.

  • Act as the local Product Specialist (incl. connectivity).

  • Monitor and evaluate short term Regional commercial performance.

  • Developing and proposing local tactical programs with relevant stakeholders (markets, after sales, R&D) to ensure business case volumes and financial targets are met.

  • Driving the local Quarterly Campaign Planning process from Product, being the regional contact window with the Sales & Markets.

  • Co-developing local short term tactical product campaigns.

Commercial Pricing

  • Monitoring competitor pricing across trims, options, and region and analyzing competitor volume developments in the Markets. Provide input on market developments to HQ (dealer offerings, margins, taxation, etc.).

  • Report pricing & volume information/analysis to HQ.

  • Provide all required information to JATO, and be the contact person.

  • Co-creation of tactical commercial pricing per product/market.

  • Analyze and develop local digital product pricing propositions.

Connectivity

  • Implement & activate the connectivity product offer in the market

  • Cascading and educating the local organization on the connectivity strategy and product portfolio

  • Own the local connectivity process

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

  • Understanding the dealer/importer automotive business model.

  • Strong project management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

  • Ability to align regional sales & marketing initiatives with broader business goals and adapt European strategies to local market needs.

  • Knowledge of EV technology, market trends, and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience in sales, after-sales, and logistics is a plus.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, project management tools, and CRM software.

  • Fluent Dutch / French / English speaker is required.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in equivalent role or commercial automotive business such as an OEM NSC or big dealer group

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline is required.

To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note that due to GDPR regulations we can only accept applications sent through the recruitment system, not via email or other channels. We do not accept applications submitted by external recruitment companies.
